g.text: Saved GEARS scalar distribution: a partial diagnostic only

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #696969

g.text: Each point is one held-out condition averaged over three optimisation seeds (n = 50 per dataset–scale cell). Prediction vectors were not retained, so output–training-mean correlation, gene order, and non-degeneracy cannot be tested.
